r: かんにんぶくろのおがきれる
lit: the cord tying shut one's bag of patience snaps

use.how: Usually ついに / とうとう堪忍袋の緒が切れた: anger that bursts out after a long time of putting up with something.

near.diff: 頭に来る is anger at a single provocation; 堪忍袋の緒が切れる is patience giving out after long endurance.

cue: For months your flatmate has left dirty dishes in the sink despite your polite requests. Tonight, seeing the pile again, you finally explode.

ctx.en: He's late however many times I tell him, and finally my patience snapped.

ctx.en: After night after night of noise from next door, I finally lost my patience and went to complain.
